known_fraud_patterns.name: Card-Not-Present Credential Stuffing & Account Takeover
indicators: Multiple cards tested sequentially from a single device or IP within 15 minutes
Sudden browser fingerprint change on established account
High proportion of failed CVC/expiration verifications prior to approval
Cardholder billing address differs from IP geolocation
known_fraud_patterns.mitigation_action: Freeze card immediately; require biometric step-up authentication on account

known_fraud_patterns.name: Synthetic Identity Fraud Ring
indicators: Network of 3 or more accounts sharing the same device fingerprint or residential proxy subnet
Fabricated SSN profile with limited credit history but high credit limit assignment
Small micro-transactions (under $10) followed by immediate maximum limit authorization
Shared burner email domains (e.g. temporary mail services) across distinct accounts
known_fraud_patterns.mitigation_action: Freeze all connected ring accounts; initiate multi-party FinCEN SAR filing; refer to AML investigation unit

known_fraud_patterns.name: Rapid Geolocation Shift & Impossible Travel
indicators: Consecutive transactions separated by distance requiring travel velocity exceeding 500 mph
Transaction originating from known high-risk bulletproof hosting or commercial VPN node
Device language or timezone mismatch with IP geolocation
known_fraud_patterns.mitigation_action: Hold transaction; trigger push-to-mobile verification with transaction amount and merchant details

known_fraud_patterns.name: Device Spoofing & Emulator Farm
indicators: Device parameters exhibit Android emulator artifacts (e.g., generic build properties, missing sensors)
Rapid alteration of Canvas and WebGL fingerprints across transactions
Abnormal interaction timing (sub-second checkout completion without human mouse jitter)
known_fraud_patterns.mitigation_action: Block device fingerprint permanently; decline transaction; mark account for enhanced monitoring

known_fraud_patterns.name: Bust-Out / First-Party Credit Depletion
indicators: Account with 6+ months of normal low-utilization history suddenly spikes to 95%+ limit in 48 hours
Large purchases at high-liquidity merchants (electronics, gift cards, luxury goods)
Sudden change of contact phone number or primary billing email immediately before spending burst
known_fraud_patterns.mitigation_action: Place immediate temporary authorization hold on credit line; contact account owner via registered secondary phone

policies.title: Mandatory FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) Threshold
policies.rule: Any transaction or aggregated series of transactions involving known or suspected fraud totaling $5,000 or greater MUST have a FinCEN SAR drafted and reviewed.

policies.title: High-Value Account Freezing Authority
policies.rule: Freezing accounts with aggregated balance or active credit lines exceeding $10,000 requires Tier-2 Senior Analyst or Manager approval.

policies.title: Autonomous Safe Actions
policies.rule: The AI Agent is authorized to autonomously execute: temporary 2-hour transaction soft-holds, step-up MFA/biometric challenges, customer notification SMS/Push alerts, and enhanced graph monitoring tags.

policies.title: Uncertainty Threshold & Controlled Evidence Gathering
policies.rule: If fraud probability is elevated (>0.40) but agent assessment confidence is below 0.75, the agent MUST NOT take irreversible blocking actions without first gathering additional evidence (customer validation, step-up challenge, or analyst review).
